name: Thief
fantasy: The cutpurse. Sticks to one mark, flips past them, cashes in, gone again.

card.loop: Stack Marks on one target; Vault primes your next hit (land it: Vault resets). Into 3 Marks: Cash In.
card.dash: A quick flip and a burst of speed. Your next hit is Primed; land it and Vault comes straight back.
card.passive: Hits on the same target stack Marks (up to 3, +6% damage each). Knocks and assists heal you.
card.rmb: Grounds the first foe it wraps (no dash, jump or glide); catch a second and both are stunned.
card.e: Throw a dagger that sticks and slows; recast (or wait) to Shadow Step to it.
card.r: Knives at everyone near, harder with anti-heal at the rim; Marks refresh, 2 free quick Vaults.

weapons.twin_blades: Quick 3-hit combo; hold for a spin. Every hit on the same target stacks a Mark.
weapons.smg: Hold to spray; a steady stream on one target stacks Marks fast.

passive.name: Marks
passive.desc: Weapon hits on the same target you hit last stack a Mark on them (one per 0.3s, up to 3, 5s, refreshed by each): each Mark makes them take +6% from you. A hit from behind adds one more. A Primed hit into 3 Marks Cashes In: +22 damage on top, a crit, stun 0.3, the Marks spent. A knock heals you 12% of your health (an assist 8%) and resets Vault.

dash.name: Vault
dash.desc: A 3.4m flip (shots pass through it) and +30% speed for 1.4s. Your next weapon hit within 3s is Primed: +10 damage, 2 Marks and Shred (+15% damage taken for 3s). Landing it resets Vault.

variants.tap: Throw a spinning Bola 10m: 8 damage, a Mark, and the first foe it wraps is Grounded for 1.5s (no dash, jump or glide; slowed 25%). If a second foe is within 3m of them the cords catch both: +12 damage and stun 0.9 each.
variants.air: Thrown from the air the same way.

e.name: Shadow Knife
e.desc: Throw a dagger 10m: on a foe it sticks for 1.6s (9 damage, a Mark, slowed 30%); a miss sticks where it lands. Press E again to Shadow Step to it, behind the foe it's in; if you wait you step when it falls out. Your next hit after the step counts as from behind.

r.name: Jackpot
r.desc: A 0.45s fuse you can keep shooting through, then a knife at every foe within 8.5m in sight: 16 damage, and past 5m (the rim) +10 and blight 3s (healing barely takes). Everyone hit gets a Mark and all your Marks refresh. For 4s you have 2 quick Vaults (2.4m, they Prime too) that cost no charge.

rank2.ult: Rank 2 (level 9): cooldown 95s -> 80.8s, +15% damage; a 3rd quick Vault.

rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 12s -> 9.6s, damage +30%; the dagger sticks 2.2s.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 7s -> 4.9s; the Primed hit adds 3 Marks.

tells.half: gold Mark diamonds over the target, a gold blade glint while Primed
tells.full: a spinning gold coin over a 3-Mark target and a coin jingle
tells.dash_spent: a smoke afterimage, dash pip dark
